note: NOT A ROBUSTNESS GUARANTEE. Simulated Monte Carlo (mc_designs.py) of the failure probability of the basin-aware design BA(b) (basin_aware.json) and of the reference design auth10 (fair_designs.json: Eq. 14 with a 10 % voltage margin, g <= 3000 V s/m, at its checked depth a_chk) under the same N samples of the +-10 % model errors of mc_kick.py (cutting coefficients, modal frequency and damping, actuator constant, runout, clip level, loop delay). Failure(b): the cut does not settle (the 1e-4 m/s kick of mc_kick.py already ends in chatter at one of the phases 0, 4, 8, 12 of 16) or a kick of exactly b at one of these phases ends in chatter (judged once per revolution over the 300 revolutions after the kick). 'own': each design at its own depth; 'common': both at min(a_ref, a_rob(b)), each with its own gain. With N samples the binomial error is large (0 failures in 100 samples still allow 3.6 % at 95 %), one kick size is tried at 4 phases of one tooth period after one face entry, and the same samples serve every speed, so the pooled interval and McNemar p are approximate (the sample-level sign test is not affected by that dependence).

comparisons.own: ref at (g_ref, a_ref) vs BA(b) at (g*(b), a_rob(b))
comparisons.common: both at a_c = min(a_ref, a_rob(b)), each with its own gain

protocol.unsettled: the kick of DV_LO = 1e-4 m/s ends in chatter at one of the phases 0, 4, 8, 12 (run in this order, stopping at the first): mc_kick.critical_kick 'unsettled' at any phase, as in mc_kick.worst_phase
protocol.failure: unsettled, or a kick of exactly b at one of the phases 0, 4, 8, 12 (in this order, stopping at the first chatter) ends in chatter
protocol.run: mc_kick.make_runner(rpm, a, vclip, runout, psi, tau_sim, g): face entry, nreg 0, |V| <= vclip, kick in revolution 100, 300-revolution window
protocol.judge: tdboundary.classify_run once per revolution (N = 1); the per-tooth verdict is recorded
protocol.closed_form: diagnostic: mc_kick.closed_form's linear-stability test with mc_common.Model at the design gain
protocol.statistics: Clopper-Pearson two-sided 95 %; exact two-sided McNemar (binomial test of the discordant pairs at p = 1/2); pooled over speeds: the same counts (approximate: shared samples) and a sample-level exact sign test

nominal_vs_basin_aware_validation.note: per-tooth verdicts of the nominal runs at the BA design points against basin_aware's validation (same simulator build and protocol): the kick of b at the phase (stored verdict), and the stored critical kick at the phase (a kick of b chatters iff b >= critical kick; the DV_LO kick chatters iff the stored critical kick is nan)

samples_rev_vs_tooth.note: information: with runout the per-tooth classifier calls the settled spindle-periodic orbit chatter (mc_kick.py); the verdict is per revolution
